name: Document Loader: AI Automator
description: Provides AI Automator types that extract document content via Document Loader and place it into destination fields.
project_description: Document Loader: AI Automator provides AI Automator plugin types that read a source field (file, image, media, link, or text), extract its document content through the Document Loader pipeline, and write the result into a destination field. It requires no AI provider — extraction and format conversion are handled natively by Document Loader — so it runs reliably on entity save, cron, VBO, or ECA. One plugin is provided per destination field type (text_long, text_with_summary, string_long, plus JSON variants), and output formats are discovered dynamically from installed loader plugins.
